heading: Glaucoma flow sheet
helpFromExam: IOP uses applanation when recorded, otherwise Tono-Pen (finger tension is not charted). The last 20 visits are shown; visits after this exam are left out.
helpNoExam: IOP uses applanation when recorded, otherwise Tono-Pen (finger tension is not charted). The last 20 visits are shown; open it from an exam to edit that exam's targets.
cannotChange: This exam cannot be changed right now.
targetsNotSaved: {error} The targets shown were not saved.
lockedSigned: This exam is signed, so its targets are read-only.
lockedHolder: {name} is editing this exam, so its targets are read-only here.
sourcePrior: from the last visit that set one
notRecordedShown: Not recorded at any visit shown.
noTimedReadings: No IOP readings with a time recorded yet.
hourChartLabel: IOP by time of day chart. The same values are in the table below.
dateChartLabel: IOP by date chart. The same values are in the table below.
dateChartDesc: Lines for IOP and target per eye; a gap means no reading at that visit. Markers below show visual field, OCT and gonioscopy dates.
datePointHigh: {date}: IOP {eye} {value} mmHg by {method}, target {target}, above target
legendTest: bar in the strip under the chart
